messages:
harper: Noticing a tail increase on short-chat p95 after we merged the early-prefetch + small-write alignment changes. GPU looks fine, host time is up ~20-28ms.

harper: Quick sample from perf-run:
```
host_overhead_ms p50: 1.3  p95: 59 (+22)  p99: 88
parse_ms p95: 12.4 (+10)
tokenize_ms p95: 6.2 (+5)
streaming_writev_calls p95: 3 (baseline: 1)
kvcache_ms p95: 0.7
```

dinesh: The early-prefetch change calls token_adapter selection and kernel blob mmap earlier to prewarm. It was intended to reduce first-token latency but may be on the hot path now. Which CL?

meera: CL id e1b2c3 11: introduced `early_prefetch_enable` + chunk-align-to-128 for the streaming writer. The prefetch does a synchronous fingerprint -> token adapter decision -> memmap(kernel_blob).

sylvia: If the fingerprint step routes to legacy adapter we hit ICU loads and memcpy work. Did anyone check fingerprint mapping coverage for http2/grpc meta?

dinesh: Fingerprint logic hashes first 48 bytes and uses a suffix fallback for ambiguous headers. The larger early-prefetch window seems to hit the fallback more often for the short prompts.

harper: Repro: used the perf-client to send 6-token prompts via grpc stream. Strace diff: slow-run shows open("/usr/lib/icu/icuuc.so", O_RDONLY) + mmap calls and 3 writev syscalls instead of 1 coalesced writev.

meera: Flamegraph points to ingress.read_frame -> early_prefetch() -> proto_unwrap -> utf8_normalize -> token_adapter_legacy. Also hotspot for writev syscalls inside streaming.write_chunk.

sylvia: Mitigation options we discussed:
- disable inline early_prefetch on ingress hot path (move to async/worker)
- shrink prefetch window to header-only quick-check (no full proto_unwrap)
- fix fingerprint table to map common grpc metadata shapes to token_adapter_v2/v3
- change chunk-align-to-128 to prefer coalescing (only split if payload > threshold)
- add ascii-only fastpath prior to utf8_normalize to avoid ICU when bytes < 0x80

dinesh: Rolling back e1b2c3 on canary now. Deploy-bot will report.

deploy-bot: rollback: reverted CL e1b2c3 on eng-runtime/canary at 16:22 UTC

harper: After rollback p95 returned to baseline within ~9m. KV stats unchanged. Confirms host parse/token + streaming framing were the root cause.

meera: I'll open a follow-up PR that: disables inline prefetch, adds header quick-check, implements ascii-fastpath, and an e2e perf test that asserts p95 < 50ms for short-stream prompts. Sylvia can take the chunker coalescing change.

sylvia: On it. I'll also add a unit test that simulates multiple grpc metadata variants to lock down the fingerprint mapping.

dinesh: Once PR is up I'll run a stateless canary with prefetch disabled and collect full traces. If traces look good we'll reintroduce prewarm as best-effort async.

harper: Thanks team. Please paste traces / strace outputs here. :thumbsup:
